description: This source file defines the 'MergedCellList' class, which manages a list of merged table cells within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes logic for initializing the list from a table, handling merged cells, calculating effective borders for rendering, and navigating neighboring cells.

classes.name: MergedCellList
classes.description: A specialized list of table cells that handles merged cells, neighbor determination, and calculation of borders for rendering in RTF and PDF formats.

methods.name: MergedCellList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list from a given table.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the list based on the table's cells, considering merged cells.

methods.name: IsAlreadyCovered
methods.description: Determines if a cell is already covered by a merged cell in the list.

methods.name: GetEffectiveBordersInternal
methods.description: Calculates the effective borders for a cell, considering neighbors and rendering context (RTF/PDF).

methods.name: GetCoveringCell
methods.description: Returns the cell that covers a specified cell due to merging.

methods.name: GetBorderFromBorders
methods.description: Retrieves a specific border from a Borders object, cloning it if necessary.

methods.name: GetEffectiveBorderWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a border of a specified type, considering inheritance if not explicitly set.

methods.name: GetNeighborTop
methods.description: Gets the top neighbor cell, considering heading repetitions for PDF.

methods.name: IsNeighbor
methods.description: Deprecated method to determine if one cell is a neighbor of another at a specified position.

methods.name: IsNeighborBottom
methods.description: Checks if one cell is directly below another.

methods.name: IsNeighborLeft
methods.description: Checks if one cell is directly to the left of another.

methods.name: IsNeighborRight
methods.description: Checks if one cell is directly to the right of another.

methods.name: IsNeighborTop
methods.description: Checks if one cell is directly above another, considering heading row overrides for PDF.

methods.name: AddHeaderInsertionRowIndex
methods.description: Records the index of a header row insertion for border calculations involving headings.

methods.name: GetLastKnownHeaderInsertionRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the last inserted header row index for internal use in border calculations.
